test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the bracketed word to fill in the blank.

It would be _________ (annoying) to watch India hosting the World Cup and winning it at the same time.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Delightful**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The bracketed word '**Annoying**' signifies something that is irritating. (चिढ़चिढ़ा)
 
• The correct antonym, '**Delightful**', implies something that is very pleasant or enjoyable. (मनोहारी)
 
• Hence, the correct antonym for '**Annoying**' is '**Delightful**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is- “**Option 4**”.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**Irksome**' refers to something that is irritating or annoying. ('उपद्रवी)
 
• '**Plaguy**' means annoying or troublesome.
 
• '**Pesky**' means annoying or troublesome, similar in meaning to 'annoying'. (परेशान करने वाला)
